Important Notes

  • All India Rank (AIR) and Score Card will be displayed in the JOAPS portal for candidates who have secured marks equal to or above the respective category Cut-Off Marks.
  • The Final Answer Key is matched to the order of questions in the Master Question Paper.
  • The order of questions and options shown during the examination may differ from the Master Question Paper.
  • Candidates should always refer to the Master Question Paper together with the corresponding Final Answer Key while verifying their responses.
  • In the Final Answer Key, MTA (Marks to All) means that marks for those questions are awarded to all candidates appearing for that test paper.
